speakers.script: Say naturally, as if a bit frustrated: Every time my colleague presents a plan, I always find at least three or four problems with it. I mean, I just can't help pointing out what's wrong, even in small details. My team says I never seem fully satisfied with anyone's work, including my own.

Say naturally, in a hesitant tone: Honestly, I agreed with the marketing plan at first, but then a colleague said it wouldn't work, so I changed my mind. Later someone else convinced me it actually was a good idea after all. I guess I just go along with whoever spoke to me most recently.

Say naturally, in a firm, no-nonsense tone: I don't accept late submissions, no exceptions, no excuses. If the deadline is Friday at noon, it's Friday at noon. My team knows I won't bend the rules, even for a good reason, because standards matter more than comfort.

Say naturally, sounding a little unpredictable: One morning I was thrilled about the new project, joking with everyone in the office. By the afternoon, I didn't want to talk to anyone at all, and nobody really knew why. My assistant says she never knows which version of me she'll get each day.
